#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""
import os
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
TODAY = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# 1. Create the cover page
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title centered
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 40, TITLE)

# Current date below title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 10, TODAY)

# Decorative line between title and date
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 + 15, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 + 15)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER} with title '{TITLE}' and date '{TODAY}'")

# 2. Merge cover page with the original report
if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"{INPUT} not found in the workspace")

reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages "
      f"({len(reader.pages)} original + 1 cover)")
